title: Vanilla Vibes
body:
**⚔️ A New Era of Minecraft Adventure**

Minecraft has been transformed into a deeper, more challenging **RPG survival** experience where exploration, progression, and combat all matter more than ever.

The world is larger and more dangerous, filled with massive dungeons, ruined cities, deep catacombs, towering ships, and a mysterious new dimension waiting to be discovered. Even vanilla structures like strongholds, nether fortresses, and mineshafts have been expanded and improved to feel more epic and rewarding.

Progression drives everything. Level up your skills, find rare artifacts, and collect unique weapons that each change your playstyle. Craft and upgrade powerful armor sets as you prepare for increasingly deadly challenges.

Every encounter is more intense—bosses like the Ender Dragon, Wither, and Warden have been reworked into brutal fights, alongside new custom bosses built to push your build and skill to the limit.

Survival is also about preparation. Grow new crops, cook meals with useful buffs, brew drinks, upgrade your storage, and gear up with backpacks and helpful tools for long adventures.

The world also feels more alive than ever, with completely new animations for every mob—including players.

With enhanced terrain, improved visuals, and plenty of quality-of-life upgrades, the game stays smooth and familiar while feeling completely new.

**This is Minecraft—evolved into an RPG adventure.**

_Might experience minor bugs due to keybinds/texture packs conflicting, these issues are easy to fix manually_
